class.name: OcgTopodsSolid
class.brief_description: Describes a solid shape which - references an underlying solid shape with the potential to be given a location and an orientation - has a location for the underlying shape, giving its placement in the local coordinate system - has an orientation for the underlying shape, in terms of its geometry (as opposed to orientation in relation to other shapes).
